svg.aria-label: dev-kit architecture: main agent, skills, library tiers, per-task folder, workers, tools and the learning pipeline
svg.title: dev-kit architecture
svg.text: CONTINUAL LEARNING: lessons become library edits, only with your approval
18 how-to files, named by checklist steps
17 long-tail files, loaded on a trigger
durable notes, read at the start of every task
local until you approve; nothing reaches the shared library without a reviewed diff
Ask: you describe the work, AGENTS.md routes it to a skill, and the skill skims the principles digest first.
Work and log: every step lands in the ledger, a short state.md keeps the current picture, tests run quietly.
Delegate: big or independent work goes to workers on any CLI; they report back through handoff files.
Learn: lessons are queued locally, dev-learn drafts a library change on a branch, and nothing merges without you.
